findings.title: Pause and Delete still require the removed Ruler data
findings.description:
`GrafanaRuleListItem` now supplies only `promRule`, but Pause remains gated on `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)`, and Delete remains gated on `rulerRule` at line 165. Consequently, neither action appears for Grafana rules in the new list, even when the new ability checks grant permission.

Adapt the menu actions to accept the Prometheus rule’s UID, paused state, and group identifier, fetching Ruler data on demand only if needed. Add integration tests that exercise Pause and Delete from the Prometheus-only list; the new four-item menu assertion currently accepts their disappearance.

findings.title: Silence notifications becomes a no-op in the new list
findings.description:
The menu can now display “Silence notifications” using Prometheus-rule permissions, and clicking it sets `showSilenceDrawer` to `true`. However, rendering the drawer still requires `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)`. The new `GrafanaRuleListItem` never supplies `rule`, so the drawer never opens.

Update the drawer boundary to accept the Prometheus rule’s UID, or load the required data when the action is selected. Add a test that clicks Silence and verifies that the editor opens, rather than checking only that the menu item exists.

findings.title: Combined-rule abilities lose federated-group immutability
findings.description:
`useAllAlertRuleAbilities` previously checked `isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` before permitting mutation. It now delegates to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`, which hardcodes `isFederated = false` at line 245 and receives no group metadata.

For Mimir groups containing `source_tenants`, existing consumers of `useAlertRuleAbility`, including the legacy rule action buttons, can now offer editing when permissions allow it. Preserve the federated-group restriction in the combined-rule adapter or pass the relevant group metadata into the shared implementation, and cover this case with a regression test.
